blocks.text: Sugar Loaf, Historic Rio and the Parade of Champions

provenance.rationale: Combines the approved Day 2 Sugar Loaf and Champions Parade heading with its historic Rio itinerary.

blocks.text:
Day 2 · Breakfast, then a 4-hour tour: the cable car to Morro da Urca, with its wide observation deck, and on to Sugar Loaf, with views of Copacabana, the bay, the islands, the bridge to Niterói and Christ the Redeemer, then old Rio, with its historic churches, monasteries, Metropolitan Cathedral and colonial buildings. Rest in the afternoon before the big night.

Evening · The Parade of Champions at the Sambadrome: the winning samba schools of Carnival 2027 parade once more, with their spectacular costumes and floats, in a joyful, festive night of music and dance. Transfer back to the hotel after the parade.

blocks.text: Day 3 · Breakfast, then a 4-hour excursion to Corcovado: an open train climbs through the Tijuca Forest to the statue of Christ the Redeemer (38 m), at about 710 m, inaugurated in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, the Maracanã Stadium and Sugar Loaf. We recommend watching the sunset from the rocks of Arpoador, and seafood at the Marius restaurant in the evening (around USD 130 per person).
